facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: loss of containment at PR-9410 during shift handover

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control LIFTING_GEAR_INSPECTION: the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on PR-9410 and ACC-9410 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and executing a lift, specifically selecting and inspecting lifting gear. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear was never verified as effective. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 23 December 2013 an incident occurred on PR-9410 and ACC-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during shift handover, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
